context: Booking App Marketplace (Indian Context) - Warm, trust-building, mobile-first

headings.usage: Use tracking-tight for H1/H2 to give a premium feel.

body.usage: Use for all body text, provider descriptions, and UI labels.

scales.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tighter text-[#1A1A1A]

spacing_and_layout.app_container: max-w-md mx-auto sm:max-w-xl md:max-w-3xl lg:max-w-5xl md:px-6 relative min-h-screen bg-[#F9F8F6] md:bg-white md:shadow-2xl md:border-x border-[#E5E2DA]

header.style: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F9F8F6]/85 border-b border-[#E5E2DA] sticky top-0 z-40 px-4 py-3 flex items-center justify-between

bottom_navigation.style: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 bg-white border-t border-[#E5E2DA] pb-safe pt-2 px-6 flex justify-around items-center md:hidden z-50 rounded-t-2xl shadow-[0_-4px_24px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)]
bottom_navigation.active_state: text-[#2C3E35] flex flex-col items-center gap-1 scale-105 transition-transform
bottom_navigation.inactive_state: text-[#A3A3A3] flex flex-col items-center gap-1 hover:text-[#5E5E5E]

provider_card.container: bg-white border border-[#E5E2DA] rounded-2xl p-4 flex gap-4 transition-all duration-200 hover:shadow-[0_8px_24px_rgba(26,26,26,0.08)] hover:-translate-y-0.5 cursor-pointer
provider_card.image_wrapper: w-24 h-24 shrink-0 rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-[#F3F0E9]

category_card.container: flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-3 rounded-2xl text-center gap-2 border border-transparent transition-all hover:bg-white hover:shadow-sm hover:border-[#E5E2DA] cursor-pointer
category_card.icon_wrapper: w-14 h-14 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-2xl

booking_flow.time_slot: border border-[#E5E2DA] text-[#1A1A1A] rounded-xl py-3 px-4 text-center cursor-pointer transition-all hover:border-[#2C3E35] bg-white
booking_flow.service_item: flex justify-between items-center p-4 border border-[#E5E2DA] rounded-xl bg-white

forms.input: w-full bg-white border border-[#E5E2DA] rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-base text-[#1A1A1A] placeholder:text-[#A3A3A3] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#2C3E35]/20 focus:border-[#2C3E35] outline-none transition-all
forms.label: block text-sm font-semibold text-[#1A1A1A] mb-1.5

live_queue.container: bg-[#2C3E35] text-white p-6 rounded-2xl flex flex-col items-center text-center gap-2 shadow-lg
live_queue.status_pulse: flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-[#A3B1A9] uppercase tracking-widest font-bold

empty_state.container: flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-12 px-4 text-center gap-4
empty_state.icon_wrapper: w-20 h-20 bg-[#F3F0E9] rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-[#5E5E5E] text-3xl
empty_state.title: text-xl font-bold text-[#1A1A1A]

icons.instructions: Use 'Regular' weight for general UI. Use 'Fill' weight for active bottom navigation icons. Use large sizes (32px+) for category icons.

image_urls.description: Chic modern beauty salon, use for salon category headers or default provider images.
Hospital lobby reception, use for healthcare clinic headers.
Technician handling repair, use for home services.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Google Fonts: Outfit (Headings) and Manrope (Body). Update tailwind.config.js to include them.

Implement a mobile-first layout. The main container should have 'max-w-md mx-auto' on desktop to simulate a mobile app view, or expand to a split view if preferred, but keep the mobile experience as the priority.
For the login screen, implement an India-focused OTP flow (+91 prefix hardcoded or default, 10-digit phone, 6-digit OTP).
Home screen categories should display Bilingual text if possible, e.g., 'Healthcare / स्वास्थ्य'.
Map the DB accent colors (teal, amber, green, gray, red, sage, blue) to the tailwind classes defined in colors.category_accents.
Use Shadcn UI for complex components like Dialogs, Calendars, but override their default styles to match the rounded-2xl, earthy aesthetic defined above.
Ensure the Live Queue token number uses the 'live_queue.token_text' massive typography.
Add the appropriate data-testid attributes to all interactive elements.
